analysis_depth.instructions: Choose the minimum analysis depth needed for this security candidate.

criteria.fast: A localized security signal with no cross-boundary reasoning required.
criteria.standard: A security-relevant candidate needing nearby control-flow or configuration review.
criteria.deep: A potentially high-impact, attacker-controlled, cross-function, authorization, SSRF, or business-logic path requiring adversarial validation.

context_profile.instructions: Choose the security context profile that best fits the candidate.

criteria.injection: Untrusted data can reach an interpreter, query, template, or command sink.
criteria.authentication: Identity, token, session, or credential handling.
criteria.authorization: Access control, tenancy, object ownership, or privilege checks.
criteria.ssrf: Server-side requests or browser-backed renderers can reach remote or internal resources.
criteria.business_logic: Security impact depends on workflow state, values, or domain invariants.
criteria.general: A security candidate outside the named profiles.
